thread.title: Advanced Window Products Announces September Promotion on Hurricane Impact-Resistant Windows
thread.title_full: Advanced Window Products Announces September Promotion on Hurricane Impact-Resistant Windows

author: The Pilot News
title: Advanced Window Products Announces September Promotion on Hurricane Impact-Resistant Windows
text:
Advanced Window Products Advanced Window Products has announced a September promotion offering 30% off qualifying hurricane-impact-resistant windows for customers purchasing 10 or more units. The limited-time offer runs through September 30, 2026, giving Houston-area homeowners an opportunity to upgrade storm protection and energy efficiency. The company provides professional window installation, replacement solutions, and various custom window options designed to improve home comfort, security, and performance. Pasadena, Texas - September 2, 2026 - Advanced Window Products has announced a special promotion for September, offering customers 30% off all hurricane-impact-resistant windows for a limited time. The promotion is available on qualifying purchases of 10 or more windows and will remain in effect through the end of September.
The September promotion offers customers planning a hurricane-impact-resistant window project the opportunity to take advantage of a reduced price during the promotional period. To qualify for the offer, customers must purchase at least 10 hurricane-impact-resistant windows. The 30% discount applies to eligible window purchases that meet the stated minimum requirement.
The promotion is available for a limited time and will expire September 30, 2026. Customers interested in the offer must meet the minimum purchase requirement and complete their qualifying purchase within the promotional period. Advanced Window Products is making the September offer available exclusively for hurricane impact-resistant windows as part of this month-long promotion.
Window Services and Replacement Solutions from Advanced Window Products
Advanced Window Products provides a broad selection of residential window replacement and installation solutions for homeowners throughout Houston and surrounding areas. Their offerings include hurricane- and energy-efficient windows, custom replacement windows, NT Windows 1800 Series options, and multiple window styles to accommodate diverse architectural and performance requirements.
Hurricane-Resistant Window Solutions For homeowners searching for hurricane-proof windows in Houston , Advanced Window Products offers hurricane-impact-resistant options engineered to help protect homes during severe weather. Their hurricane window solutions are designed to withstand high winds and impacts while also enhancing home security. Customers can work with the company to identify window configurations suited to their property, replacement needs, and overall project requirements.
Professional Window Installation Advanced Window Products also provides professional installation for homeowners considering replacement windows in Houston . Their installation process includes accurate measurements, proper fitting, careful sealing, and final inspection to support dependable long-term window performance. The company works with homeowners from the initial consultation and window selection through installation and project completion.
Impact and Energy-Efficient Window Options Homeowners looking for hurricane impact windows in Houston can choose solutions that combine storm protection with features designed to enhance energy efficiency and indoor comfort. Advanced Window Products also offers energy-efficient window options designed to reduce heat transfer and improve insulation. These products can be considered by homeowners seeking improvements related to protection, efficiency, comfort, and property appearance.
Window Styles and Custom Replacement Options The company's available window styles include casement, sliding, picture, awning, double-hung, and bay windows, as well as custom replacement options. Advanced Window Products also offers the NT Windows 1800 Series, including an exclusive non-impact 1800 Series model manufactured by NT Windows specifically for the company. These choices allow homeowners to select window configurations based on their home's design, ventilation needs, energy-efficiency goals, and other project considerations.
About Advanced Window Products
Advanced Window Products is a family-owned window replacement company founded by Mike Wright in 1997 after he had spent 15 years installing windows throughout Houston. Based in Pasadena, Texas, the company serves homeowners across Houston and surrounding communities with vinyl replacement windows, hurricane-resistant options, energy-efficient solutions, and professional installation. Their approach focuses on personalized customer care, dependable workmanship, and helping homeowners select window solutions suited to their individual properties and needs.
